sources.design: RCT,n=48; primary follow-up81%; both groups active treatment.
sources.population: Adults with ultrasound-verified plantar fasciitis and heel pain≥3 months.
sources.coInterventions: Both gel heel inserts and education/activity advice.
sources.outcomes: FFI favored strength at3 months by29 points (95%CI6–52); no between-group difference at1,6,12 months.
sources.uncertainty: Small sample/attrition; short-term improvement not durable superiority. Toe-extension setup conflicts with independent first-MTP range limits.
sources.harms: Minor delayed-onset soreness in strength arm; no other adverse events reported.
sources.limitations: Small sample/attrition; short-term improvement not durable superiority. Toe-extension setup conflicts with independent first-MTP range limits. Research candidate only; no clinical release.

protocol.execution: Unilateral heel raise on stair with towel under toes, maximal toe dorsiflexion at top; backpack loading; bilateral start if unable. Comparator seated crossed-leg fascia stretch, hand pulls toes toward shin and other hand palpates fascia.
protocol.dose: Heel raise: three seconds up, two seconds at top, three seconds down; 3 × 12RM initially, 4 × 10RM after two weeks, 5 × 8RM after four weeks. Stretch: 10 × 10 seconds.
protocol.frequency: Strength every second day for three months; stretch three times daily.
protocol.supervision: Physiotherapist instruction and performance check/correction after one month.
protocol.progression: Backpack books added as strength improved; bilateral start as needed.
protocol.stoppingRules: not reported as a verified universal pain threshold.

exerciseMappings.matchRationale: Catalog execution ledger shows staggered wall-supported stance, rear heel down. This is a candidate for the guideline general calf stretch; exact straight-/bent-knee emphasis is not verified. Duration/stretch identity earns no strength credit.
Generic calf-raise records do not encode the towel-under-toes windlass setup. First-MTP or insertional Achilles restrictions can make this exact execution inappropriate.
Wall calf stretch has a different execution and target setup. This is flexibility work; it cannot receive strength-set credit or generic five-second progression.

proposedRules.statement: Consider foot/ankle resistance and plantar-fascia/calf flexibility candidates after diagnosis and review. Check the towel-toe variant against toe-extension and insertional Achilles restrictions; stretching receives no strength-set credit.
